text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, K.S.Miracle was reading
a fan letter addressed to her.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I was so happy
that I've reread it tons of times already.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Letters like this have always
saved me, since way back."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
When I was a kid, I was in the hospital the whole time,
so all my classmates wrote letters for me—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
""Get well soon!" "You'll definitely get better!"
"Everyone's waiting for you!" "Once you're better,
let's play together!" ...Hehe."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Letters are wonderful, aren't they?
They convey raw, undecorated feelings directly to you."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: The same goes for fan letters.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: In the final stretch of the race, when I'm out of breath and feel like I can't go on anymore—it's the letters the fans sent me that push me forward.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Watching you run gave me courage." "Keep doing your best!" "I can't wait to see you win!"...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whenever those words cross my mind, I think to myself—
I have to win to make it up to everyone!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So... hehe. My fans always tell me
that I've saved them, but—
truth is, I'm the one who's been saved.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I need to work even harder. I have to properly repay everyone for all they've given me!
choice_data_list: I'll do my best together with you, too!
I'll do my best right alongside you!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you so much! ...Someday,
I'll be sure to repay the favor to you too!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Alright.
I'll go for a quick run then!
choice_data_list: That said, overworking yourself is a no-no, okay?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I know.
It's only going to be a light run, after all.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Reading those letters made my chest burn.
I don't think I can fall asleep unless I go for a run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Receiving fan letters filled
K.S.Miracle with motivation.
